# Exercício 1

```{r}
library(readr)

cadastro <- read_delim(
  "dados/cadastro.csv",
  delim = ";",
  locale = locale(
    decimal_mark = ".",
    encoding = "ISO-8859-1"
  ),
  na = "",
  col_types = cols(
    codigo = col_character(),
    nome = col_character(),
    padrao = col_character(),
    quartos = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diarias_2023 <- read_delim(
  "dados/diarias_2023.csv",
  delim = ";",
  locale = locale(
    decimal_mark = ".",
    encoding = "US-ASCII"
  ),
  na = "-",
  col_types = cols(
    codigo = col_character(),
    jan = col_double(),
    fev = col_double(),
    mar = col_double(),
    abr = col_double(),
    mai = col_double(),
    jun = col_double(),
    jul = col_double(),
    ago = col_double(),
    set = col_double(),
    out = col_double(),
    nov = col_double(),
    dez = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

```
